title: Why I am a radical teacher
text: well I've always been a radical spiritual teacher because I've always felt it's always seemed to me for some reason that when we became interested in spiritual awakening and enlightenment and the evolution of consciousness that it really was about going all the way and not compromising so I've been the kind of teacher that has endeavored to go all the way myself and not compromise myself and as a teacher I've called as many people as possible to this same lack of compromise and total commitment to the evolution of consciousness and ultimately whose create a revolution in consciousness and culture if possible because when we awaken to spirit we our heart explodes our mind expands we we we discover a world of infinite potential and infinite possibility that calls us to actualize and manifest it so giving everything to that possibility of that potential is really what I'm all about and why I'm such a radical individual
